title: Find the safe ANN operating point
description: Choose an index and filter plan, then spend search effort until recall clears the workload floor without breaking its latency budget. The figures form a transparent planning model, not a vendor benchmark.

workloads.label: Support knowledge base
workloads.detail: A tenant-scoped RAG corpus with frequent article updates.

workloads.label: Legal evidence retrieval
workloads.detail: A larger corpus where missing a relevant passage has a high review cost.

workloads.label: Product discovery
workloads.detail: A broad catalog with a tight interaction budget and selective inventory filters.

indexes.label: Exact flat search
indexes.detail: Scores every eligible vector and provides the ground-truth recall reference.

indexes.label: HNSW graph
indexes.detail: Traverses a multilayer proximity graph; more search effort explores more candidates.

indexes.label: IVF plus product quantization
indexes.detail: Searches selected partitions and compressed vectors, then reranks a bounded candidate set.

filterPlans.label: Indexed pre-filter
filterPlans.detail: Use an indexed authorization and metadata predicate while building the ANN candidate path.

filterPlans.label: Search, then post-filter
filterPlans.detail: Retrieve a fixed global candidate set and discard ineligible items afterward.
